database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: The owner approved a dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). The last direct Console confirmation on 5 November showed Free and a $0 invoice. On 6 November, Prisma CLI measured 6,498 Production database operations and zero listed backups. The sum of all 9 databases in the five listed projects is 30,073 operations; this is a derived estimate, not a direct workspace meter, and current plan/invoice could not be refreshed through the CLI. The Production database is ready and lists five credential records, but per-credential health is unavailable. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; Free has no automatic backups, and routine backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-06 01:26 UTC derived workspace sum of 30,073/200,000, about 169,927 operations remained. That supports approximately 354 two-hour two-player guest sessions (480 room polls each) or 177 two-hour four-player guest sessions (960 room polls each) before all other queries, using the estimated headroom. Two tabs polling continuously would add 172,800 operations in a 30-day month, leaving only 27,200 under the nominal Free limit before any other app/workspace usage; four tabs would add 345,600 and exceed the monthly allowance. Presence adds about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session. These are source-based estimates, not measured polling traffic or capacity acceptance.
